title: Create Daily Backup
description: Create a timestamped daily backup suitable for cron or CI automation.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

SOURCE="${SOURCE:-$HOME/data}"
BACKUP_DIR="${BACKUP_DIR:-$HOME/backups}"

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
ARCHIVE="$BACKUP_DIR/backup-$DATE.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE" -C "$(dirname "$SOURCE")" "$(basename "$SOURCE")"

echo "Daily backup created: $ARCHIVE"
